## Barrier parking

A 4-space car park has an entry barrier and an exit barrier. Inputs: `entry_request` and
`exit_request` (a car is waiting in front of the entry / exit barrier) and `car_present` (cell under a barrier,
true as long as a car is in it), provided by the 3D scene (Interface → 3D scene menu).
Outputs: `entry_barrier`, `exit_barrier` (opening) and `full` (indicator).
The number of occupied spaces is tracked in `spaces`, displayed on the console. The "Arrival" and "Departure" buttons
of the scene make cars appear, which line up and only move forward if their barrier is open.

### Work to do

1. On `entry_request`, if the car park is not full: open the entry barrier, increment `spaces`.
2. On `exit_request`, if the car park is not empty: open the exit barrier, decrement `spaces`.
3. Turn on `full` as soon as all spaces are occupied and refuse new entries.
4. Close the barrier once the car has gone through (`car_present`), then validate in simulation with the 3D scene.
